findings.evidence: Line 45 `@[expose] public section`; repo practice is `public section` + `_def := (rfl)`, e.g. `QFT/Scattering/Photoproduction/Kinematics/Basic.lean:41,85` (`energy_def ... := (rfl)`) and `QFT/Scattering/DIS/Polarized/Kinematics.lean:117` (`longitudinalSpin_def ... := (rfl)`).
findings.fix: Use plain `public section` and add `xi_def`, `beta_def` (and keep `MX2_def`) stated with `:= (rfl)` so downstream never depends on defeq.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `xi`, `beta`, `MX2`; no consumer needs to unfold or compute them, and `xi`/`beta` have no `*_def` restatement at all (only `MX2` has one).

findings.evidence: `Diffractive/Basic.lean:105-106`: `unfold DisKinematics.xBj ExclKinematics.toDisKinematics xi beta DisKinematics.Q2 ExclKinematics.Q2` — the PR's own theorem cannot use the new map without unfolding it.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma toDisKinematics_Q2 (g) (K) : K.toDisKinematics.Q2 g = K.Q2 g := (rfl)` and the corresponding `toDisKinematics_xBj` (plus `W2`/`yInel` restatements), and restate `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` using them instead of `unfold`.
findings.issue: `toDisKinematics` is shipped with the five field lemmas but no lemma for the derived invariants it exists to transport: `K.toDisKinematics.Q2 g = K.Q2 g`, `K.toDisKinematics.xBj g`, `W2`, `yInel`. The characteristic API is incomplete, so consumers must unfold the constructor.

findings.evidence: Lines 87-89; contrast `QFT/Scattering/DIS/Polarized/Kinematics.lean:117` where `longitudinalSpin_def` is deliberately not a simp lemma.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` from `MX2_def` (keep it as a plain `_def` lemma, written `:= (rfl)`), matching `longitudinalSpin_def` and `energy_def`.
findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `MX2_def` rewrites `MX2 g K` to `g K.qPrime K.qPrime` on every `simp` call, so `MX2` never survives in normal form and any later `MX2` lemma (e.g. Layer 0.1's `β = Q²/(Q² + M_X² − t)`) will not fire.

findings.evidence: Roadmap Layer 0.1 defines `M_X² = (q + Δ)²` (README.md:279); the file defines `MX2 g K = g K.qPrime K.qPrime` (line 85) and provides only `MX2_def`.
findings.fix: Add `lemma MX2_eq_q_sub_delta (g) (K) : MX2 g K = g (K.q - K.delta) (K.q - K.delta)`, proved from `delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime`.
findings.issue: The docstring asserts `M_X² = (q + Δ)²` via `hMomentum`, but no lemma states it; a consumer wanting the roadmap's defining form must re-derive it through `ExclKinematics.delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime` each time.

summary: The new diffractive module exposes all definition bodies where no consumer needs them, and the new `toDisKinematics` bridge ships field projections but none of the derived-quantity lemmas (`Q2`, `xBj`) a consumer — including this PR's own theorem — actually needs. `MX2` additionally carries a simp attribute that erases it and lacks the lemma tying it to the roadmap's `(q + Δ)²` form.
